input.quote: 12.4 Customer shall not solicit, hire, or employ any Vendor employee during the term or for twenty-four months afterward, regardless of how the employee applies.
input.rationale: Section 12.4 imposes a one-sided restrictive covenant on the Customer only: it is not mutual, covers all Vendor employees rather than only personnel directly involved in the Services, runs for the term plus 24 months rather than 12 months from the end of involvement, expressly extends to hiring and employing (a no-hire), and excludes any carve-out for general advertisements or unsolicited approaches ("regardless of how the employee applies"). It therefore fails every fallback element and sits in walk-away territory (no-hire, all Vendor personnel, 24 months). It also contradicts § 12.3, in which Vendor acknowledges we have made "no ... no-hire commitment" and are free to hire "any person who responds to general recruitment". We have taken the preferred position by converting the prohibition into confirmation that no such restriction applies to us, which also removes the internal conflict with § 12.3; a mutual, 12-month, involvement-limited non-solicit with general-advertisement and unsolicited-approach carve-outs and no no-hire remains available as a fallback.

ops.oldText: shall not solicit, hire, or employ any Vendor employee during the term or for twenty-four months afterward, regardless of how the employee applies
ops.newText: may solicit, hire, or employ Vendor employees without restriction

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept a one-sided bar on soliciting, hiring or employing any Vendor employee for the term plus 24 months with no general-recruitment carve-out, which also contradicts § 12.3 confirming we gave no no-hire commitment. Our position is no non-solicit on the Customer, so we have removed the restriction; if you need protection we can discuss a mutual 12-month non-solicit limited to personnel directly involved in the Services, with general-advertisement and unsolicited-approach carve-outs and no no-hire.
proposal.summary: Remove the one-sided non-solicit/no-hire on Customer in § 12.4, confirming no restriction.
